]

# Add a title
title = doc.add_paragraph("24小时自助入住机位置列表")
title.style = doc.styles['Heading 1']

# Add addresses
for address in addresses:
    doc.add_paragraph(address)

# Save the document
doc.save('/app/AllLocations.docx')
print("Document updated successfully")
EOF
